m1_150h_background_paragraph_1: The 150h project is a project of consisting of around 150h of work taking place during the first year of the computer science Master's program. I worked on this project under the supervision of Drs Loïc MAZO, Étienne BAUDRIER and Adrien KRÄHENBÜHL, Assistant Professors at the University of Strasbourg and Senior Researchers in the IMAGeS team of the ICube UMR 7357 laboratory.
m1_150h_background_paragraph_2: My work mostly involved C++ programming. I cleaned and improved a previous codebase written in C++ by another student. The objective of these previously written scripts was to offer a practical demonstration tool showcasing the dual algorithm in discrete geometry. The demonstration tool was intented to be used for the IPOL online journal.
